release.vehicle_scope: DVSA class-4 initial MOT tests with P, F or PRS outcomes

family_coverage.scope: Registry families with site/src/data/family_*.json, excluding withheld and held families

groups: Seat belts and supplementary restraint systems

suppression.family_n: eligible class-4 initial tests in the family
suppression.defect_cell_n: failure-item occurrences in the family and defect group
suppression.primary_rule: A row with n below 1,000 is omitted rather than published with blanks.
suppression.secondary_rule: Within a complete family slice, when exactly one prespecified defect-group cell is primarily suppressed, the next-smallest publishable cell is also omitted so the primary cell cannot be recovered by subtraction. Two or more primary suppressions already prevent reconstruction.
suppression.low_sample_rule: A published row with n from 1,000 through 5,000 inclusive has confidence=low_sample.

erratum.summary: v1 and v2 counted repeated records in the DVSA 2024 source files. v3 keeps one record per retained test ID before applying analysis filters.
erratum.method_summary: Deduplicate test results by test ID before filtering, selecting a representative by validity, completeness and lexical row order. Exclude tests whose copies disagree on vehicle identity (class, make, model or vehicle ID); set conflicting first-use dates to unknown. Remove exact duplicate failure-item rows and retain only items linked to retained tests. Compute class-4 initial-test aggregates from these cleaned inputs, with the existing age adjustment and suppression rules.

changes_from_v3: Core family and defect-group numbers unchanged (same DVSA 2024 source release); dataset_release_id updated. Added outside sources (DVSA recalls, Norway, Finland, Netherlands, NHTSA explicit pairs), mileage bands within age groups, and model-year ratios with interval verdicts — all values already shown on motriskindex.co.uk pages.
